candidate.answerReason: A 20% profit makes the selling price 120% of cost, so cost is 240 ÷ 1.2 = 200 yuan.

methods.label: Recover cost from the profit rate
methods.explanation: Let the cost price be \(x\). Then the selling price is \(x(1+20\%)=240\), so \(1.2x=240\) and \(x=200\).
methods.levelReason: Uses an inverse-percentage relationship expressed as a simple equation, within grade 7.
